story.hook: Shower curtain opens to a rainforest
story.caption_explanation_en: Steam, leaves, and an orange rescue tube turn bath time into a gentle jungle mission for a necklace lost near the drain.
story.overview_ko: 샤워 커튼 뒤 욕실이 식물과 김으로 정글처럼 보이고, 고양이가 튜브와 장난감 잠수부로 배수구 근처의 목걸이를 건져 올린다.
story.continuity_ko: 장소: 집 욕실의 같은 하얀 욕조와 타일 벽; 조명: 따뜻한 욕실등과 습기로 퍼진 확산광; 소품: 주황색 튜브, 장난감 잠수부, 은색 목걸이, 잎무늬 커튼과 화분; 흔적: 물방울 맺힌 털, 욕조 가장자리 발자국, 물결 자국, 커튼과 식물 위치 유지.

creative_fingerprint.core_prop_ko: 주황색 튜브와 장난감 잠수부, 은색 목걸이
camera_setups: 85mm close-up over rim, focused rescue action

images.camera_strategy: Medium-wide at tub height, 35mm lens, vertical 4:5; slight low angle toward curtain; steam haze; plants frame the scene.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. A domestic bathroom transformed by staging: a white tub brims shallowly; warm ceiling light diffuses through steam; potted greenery and a leafy-pattern shower curtain create a lush rainforest feel. The attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat—natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby mouth marking (not food or dirt); round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face; identical anatomy and proportions to all images—stands on the tub rim, forepaws spaced naturally, gently pulling the leafy curtain aside with one paw. A bright orange rescue tube floats in the tub near a tiny toy diver. Water beads cling to tile and rim; steam glows; subtle sensor grain; soft highlight roll-off; restrained cinematic color grade. High-end editorial realism; accurate reflections/shadows; individual guard hairs visible with humidity. Safety: very shallow warm water, non-slip mat, cat free to move; staged plants. Exclude: plastic/waxy fur, excessive HDR, fake bokeh, wrong reflections, floating props, duplicate animals/limbs, human hands, logos/text.

images.camera_strategy: Tight action close-up from tub rim, 85mm lens, vertical 4:5; shallow depth of field; diagonal composition toward the drain.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. Close-up from the tub rim toward the water’s surface: the orange tube drifts as the toy diver bobs beside it. Near the drain, a silver necklace glints on pale porcelain just beneath the waterline. The attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat (exact same identity and appearance: warm orange tabby with darker stripes, white muzzle-to-belly and four white paws, congenital orange mouth marking, amber-brown eyes, pink nose, dense short fur, whiskers, rounded cheeks, identical size/age) leans in, eyes intent, whiskers forward, one white paw delicately nudging the tube toward the necklace. Natural weight and balance on the rim; droplets bead on paw fur; small ripples radiate from contact. Realistic lighting through steam, accurate scale and reflections, lifelike metal chain texture. Motion-appropriate blur on the tube edge; subtle sensor grain; gentle highlight roll-off; restrained cinematic grade. Safety: shallow water, stable stance. Exclude: cartoonish look, over-sharp halos, fake bokeh, floating objects, duplicate limbs, text/logos.

images.camera_strategy: Unusual viewpoint: underwater up-angle through the clear tub wall, 24mm lens, vertical 4:5; bubbles and surface ripples as natural frame.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. Underwater POV from inside the tub looking up through clear water and side wall: surface ripples shimmer overhead; small bubbles rise along the orange tube. The toy diver, now wedged helpfully beneath the silver necklace, pushes it upward so the necklace rests securely across the tube. Above, distorted by refraction, the attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat (identical features and proportions: bright orange tabby with darker stripes, white muzzle-to-belly, four white paws, congenital orange mouth marking, amber-brown eyes, pink nose, whiskers, short dense fur) peers down with soft, relieved eyes; one white paw hovers just above the surface ready to lift the tube out. The leafy curtain and plants form green reflections on the water underside, matching earlier staging. Realistic physics: correct refraction, caustics, bubbles, metal sheen, and shadows; accurate scale; natural sensor grain; soft highlight roll-off; restrained cinematic grade. High-end editorial realism. Safety: very shallow warm water, controlled staging. Exclude: plastic fur, exaggerated HDR, fake bokeh, wrong shadows/reflections, duplicate cats/limbs, human hands, text/logos.
